messages:
Lia (Auric): urgent — since 09:02 were seeing sustained TPS SLO violations on our Dedicated pool: a mix of 429s and 500ms+ tail latency. This started right after a promotional email went out. Can you triage? account=auric-prod, pool=dedicated-us-east-2.

Maya (Support): thanks Lia — sorry about that :grimacing:. Escalating to infra + runtime. Can you paste a minimal repro (curl) and any request ids you have?

Lia (Auric): minimal repro below, got repeated 429s within ~100ms window: 
```
curl -s -X POST \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-4x","input":"short prompt"}'

HTTP/1.1 429
{"error":"admission:rate_limited","retry_after":10}
```
root request-id: r-0a1b2c3d

Jordan SRE: grabbing admission metrics now, can you confirm whether this is a Dedicated pool with reserved capacity or you were on burstable mode?

Lia (Auric): reserved capacity (monthly commit) + burst credits enabled. We saw the traffic spike ~08:59 and the first 429s at 09:02.

Devin (Eng-Runtime): quick snapshot from the admission controller at 09:03 (from logs):
```
admission.request_rate_tps=410
admission.active_tokens_per_sec=410
admission.burst_credits=0
autoscaler.last_scale_ts=1700000000
autoscaler.pending_scale_ops=0
queue.length=12
```
This shows burst credits depleted and autoscaler didn't kick (scale cooldown or metric threshold).

Maya (Support): noted. Jordan, Devin — any immediate mitigation we can apply for Auric to reduce errors while we root-cause? Lia, do you have a window to allow brief routing to a warm fallback model variant?

Jordan SRE: we can patch admission rules to allow temporary conservative overcommit ( +15% allowed TPS ) for 15m, that should cut the 429s while autoscaler catches up. Will need Eng-Runtime signoff.

Devin (Eng-Runtime): agree. Also need to investigate why autoscaler didn't scale: looks like scale policy has a 3m stable window + cooldown. Their spike was sharp (<2m) so it was missed. Proposal: shorten cooldown for dedicated pools with burst credits disabled, and add an immediate reactive scale when burst_credits==0 and request_rate_tps>target*1.2.

Sam (Billing): FYI burst credit refill policy for Dedicated is 1 credit per 30s per slot and max refill on reserve change; if credits hit 0 we don't refill faster automatically. We can offer a temporary manual credit top-up for incident mitigation (requires accounting approval).

Ana (PM): can we get an ETA for a short-term patch + a longer-term config change? Customer wants SLA notes and a post-incident plan.

Jordan SRE: short-term: deploy admission overcommit patch to their pool in ~15-20m (canary on staging first). Long-term: autoscaler policy update + alerting on burst_credits==0 and sustained TPS>threshold.

Devin (Eng-Runtime): creating PR with policy tweak and a runtime flag to opt into "fast-reactive-scale". Will include test harness. ETA for PR + canary: 4h.

Maya (Support): Lia — we're going to: 1) enable conservative overcommit to stop 429s (15m window), 2) request billing to top-up burst credits if needed, 3) follow up with a change to autoscaler policy. Will keep you updated every 10m. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: [staging] admission-config-canary rolled out for pool=auric-dedicated (build bld-2025.03.17-09:25) :white_check_mark:

Lia (Auric): thank you — we see error rate dipping already, tail latency improving. Please confirm when you disable overcommit and what the rollback plan is.

Jordan SRE: we'll monitor for 30m after traffic subsides, will auto-disable overcommit after window or earlier if autoscaler finishes scale. Rollback: revert admission flag and restore normal quota enforcement.

Sam (Billing): opened internal ticket BILL-7892 to approve temporary credit top-up; keeping customer informed.

Ana (PM): adding this to incident timeline + action items: shorten autoscaler cooldown for spikes, add burst_credits==0 alert, docs update for recommended headroom planning for marketing blasts.

Maya (Support): thanks team. Lia — follow-up plan: postmortem doc & recommended headroom formula (we'll run a quick calc for your expected peak) and a runbook for future promos. ETA for all items: 48h for postmortem + 1wk for autoscaler policy change.

Lia (Auric): appreciate it. Please cc me on the postmortem and billing ticket.

Devin (Eng-Runtime): note to self: add unit test for reactive-scale on burst_credits==0.

Jordan SRE: monitoring note: created alerting rule ADMISSION-CRIT-auric that fires if burst_credits==0 && moving_avg_tps>target*1.15 for 60s.

Maya (Support): closing loop for now — errors down to baseline. Reopen if anything else. :white_check_mark:
